ph: Deputy Mayor, Mr. Abdul Latif, offering the -Key to the City

w: In the evening Satsang assembly in San Jose, Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was honored by the devotees.

At 8.50 pm Swamishri arrived in the assembly held in a huge marquee. A replica of Dada Khachar’s darbar formed the stage backdrop with the marble murtis of Shri Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj, Ghanshyam Maharaj, Harikrishna Maharaj (metal), Radha-Krishna Dev, Sita-Ram and Hanumanji, Shiv-Parvatiji and Ganpatiji and Guru Parampara. The Brahmin pundits, Shri Ghanshyambhai Shukla and Mukeshbhai, were conducting the pratishtha rituals. The initial rituals had been completed by the senior sadhus: Tyagvallabh Swami, Ishwarcharan Swami and Viveksagar Swami. Swamishri performed the final rituals before Shri Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj by ‘opening the eyes’, invoking the Divine, holding a mirror and performing pujan of all the murtis. After the annakut was arranged Swamishri performed the pratishtha arti and mantra pushpanjali. Finally Swamishri blessed the congregation and praised the faith, patience and unity of the devotees of LA. Then the devotees honoured Swamishri’s Shri Harikrishna Maharaj. A nagar yatra of the murtis was carried out in the mandir precincts. The murtis were arranged on golf carts with children, teenagers, youths dressed in traditional dresses and dancing to the celebration tunes, bhajans. Sadhus and devotees joined the procession, singing dhun and bhajan. At the rear of the nagar yatra women devotees in traditional dress were singing dhun and bhajan. The murtis were then established in the Haveli foyer for darshan. The next day (16/9) Swamishri performed the rituals of the first stone-laying ceremony on the mandir kanpeeth. In the evening, children and volunteers presented a Children’s Day programme themed ‘Educational Excellence’. The invited guests were honoured: Congressman Gary Miller, Protem Mayor of Chino Hills Mr Hagman, Former Mayor of Chino Hills Mr Ed Graham, Council Member of Chino Hills Mr Bill Krueger, Orange County Superior Court Judge Mr James Gray, Planning Commissioners of Chino Hills Mr Art Bennett and Mr Adam, Engineer and Developer Mr Jan Dabrey and President of Chino Hills Medical Center Mr James Lally.
